'''Gessle Tosh''' was the younger brother of [[Jann Tosh]] as well as the twin of [[Trif Tosh]]. He alongside the rest of his family save for Jann [[Death/Legends|died]] in a skimmer accident on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
